Amazon’s Sample Mania Returns for Great Indian Festival 2026: How to Grab ₹1 and ₹99 Trial Products

What is Sample Mania?

Amazon India’s Sample Mania is a “try before you buy” feature that runs alongside the Great Indian Festival 2026. Selected brands list full‑size items at a heavily discounted sample price – ₹1, ₹99, ₹199, ₹299 or ₹499 – after a coupon is applied. The promotion began on 8 October 2026 and is refreshed daily at 3 PM.

Current Offer Landscape (as of 27 Oct 2026)

  • ₹1 tier – 11 new products added on 27 Oct, including Zanskar, DIETXP BAO, Dignity Bloom, Romsons Poochie, Miduty (×3), Cosmix, Pee Safe, Clockwork and Wellopia.
  • ₹99 tier – 14 new products added on the same day, such as TRILY, What’s Up Wellness, ArmourMe Aligner Cleanser, C (DEVICE), 9UP, Simply Herbal (×3), OSSA, Gyros Farms, Divya Himalayan and others.
  • Higher tiers (₹199, ₹299, ₹499) were last verified on 8 Oct 2026; the list changes each day, so shoppers should check the live page for the most recent items.

How to Claim a Sample (Step‑by‑Step)

  • Open the Sample Mania banner on Amazon’s Great Indian Festival homepage or use the direct link provided on the Amazon app.
  • Select a price tier – the page is divided into rows titled “Buy at INR 1”, “Buy at INR 99”, etc. Use the arrows to scroll each row.
  • Choose a product – click the item you want. The original MRP will appear crossed out; a coupon automatically reduces the payable amount to the tier price.
  • Proceed to checkout – verify the final price (₹1, ₹99, etc.) before confirming payment. Prime members typically enjoy free delivery; non‑Prime accounts may incur a delivery fee on low‑value orders.
  • Leave feedback – Amazon prompts buyers to share a short review after receiving the sample.

Eligibility Details

  • Account‑specific – Not every Amazon account sees the same sample list. Eligibility is determined by Amazon’s internal algorithm and may vary day‑to‑day.
  • Prime not required – While Prime members often avoid delivery charges, the sample price itself does not depend on Prime status.
  • Daily refresh – New items appear at 3 PM Indian Standard Time. A product that is free for one user at a given moment may be unavailable to another.

Practical Implications for Shoppers

  • Cost‑effective trial – At ₹1 (roughly the price of a cup of tea) consumers can test full‑size beauty, personal‑care, health, grocery or home‑essential products before deciding on a larger purchase.
  • Potential delivery fees – Non‑Prime users should factor in a possible ₹40 delivery charge for low‑value orders; Prime members usually receive free shipping.
  • Feedback loop – Brands use the feedback to gauge demand before scaling production, meaning the sample program benefits both manufacturers and early adopters.

Comparison with Other Amazon Sample Programs

  • Free‑zero‑price samples – Separate from Sample Mania, Amazon sometimes offers a ₹0 coupon on a limited‑time page for eligible accounts. This “free sample” page is not guaranteed to be active and is also account‑specific.
  • Prime Day “Try It First” – A similar concept appears during Prime Day, but the pricing structure and eligibility rules differ. Sample Mania’s tiered pricing is unique to the Great Indian Festival.

What Remains Uncertain

  • Exact eligibility algorithm – Amazon does not disclose how it selects accounts for each sample, leaving shoppers unable to predict eligibility.
  • Future tier updates – While the ₹1 and ₹99 tiers were refreshed on 27 Oct, the higher tiers have not been confirmed since 8 Oct. Their composition may change without notice.
  • Coupon expiration – Some older coupon codes (e.g., Bare Anatomy, Rivela) have already expired; new codes may also have limited validity periods.

How to Verify the Information

  • Visit the official Sample Mania page on Amazon India during the Great Indian Festival (link provided below).
  • Check the price tier headings and confirm the final checkout amount matches the advertised ₹1, ₹99, etc.
  • Review the banner’s four‑step guide displayed on the page for any updates.
  • For the most current list, refresh the page after 3 PM IST each day.
